entities.summary: Aleksandr Vladimirovich Frolov was the CEO of Evraz in 2007-2021, one of the largest steel producers. Since 2013, the company’s coal subsidiaries, consolidated under PJSC Raspadskaya in 2020, made it the largest Russian producer of coking coal.
